subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When the host reports the deterministic ladder green for a proposal, the review orchestrator shall build the complete required top-level assurance-pass set before PR-raise; when the proposal revision changes, it shall stale every pass and require the full set on the new exact revision.
rationale: the proposal boundary stays once-per-finished-revision, while planned critical assurance requires two independent reviews and AP-13 forbids reusing evidence across revisions
fit_criterion: every ordinary and elevated fixture builds one pass, every critical fixture builds two, zero-pass construction is rejected under UB-16, no invocation occurs inside codegate fix cycles, and any head change invalidates and reruns every required pass
